Identification_Area.title: Cassini Orbiter Radio Science Subsystem Occultation and Electron Density Derived Data

Table_Delimited.name: s19tioc2006078_0107_n_sx_14_titan_edp
Table_Delimited.description: Individual electron density profiles from an occultation. Each individual electron density profile data product was generated from two frequency data products, where the two frequency data products were received simultaneously by the same Deep Space Network Station (DSS) in different frequency bands. We used frequency bands S-band and X-band, and X-band and Ka-band, but not S-band and Ka-band. In no instances did a given DSN antenna record S-band and Ka-band together. Inspection of the user guide shows that uncertainties in the rate of change of total electron content would be significantly worse for this frequency pair than for the other possible frequency pairs. Uncertainties in electron density would be significantly worse as well. Each individual electron density profile data product contains data from either ingress or egress, but not both. Values in columns 1-13 of an average electron density profile data product match values in columns 1-13 of the associated individual electron density profile data products.

Field_Delimited.name: ETTX
Field_Delimited.description: Ephemeris time (seconds past J2000) of transmission of signal from the spacecraft. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: ETOCC
Field_Delimited.description: Ephemeris time (seconds past J2000) of signal closest approach to target body. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: ETRX
Field_Delimited.description: Ephemeris time (seconds past J2000) of reception of signal by DSN station. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: UTCTX
Field_Delimited.description: UTC time of transmission of signal from the spacecraft. (format code A30)

Field_Delimited.name: UTCOCC
Field_Delimited.description: UTC time of signal closest approach to target body. (format code A30)

Field_Delimited.name: UTCRX
Field_Delimited.description: UTC time of reception of signal by DSN station. (format code A30)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTRADIUS
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point radius. The distance between the center of the target body and the signal at the occultation point, or the closest approach to the target body. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTLAT
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point latitude. Planetocentric latitude of the occultation point. Increases positively northward. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTLON
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point longitude. Planetocentric longitude of the occultation point. Increases positively eastward. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTSZA
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point solar zenith angle. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTLST
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point local true solar time. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTSEP
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point Sun-Earth-Probe angle, where Probe is the Cassini spacecraft. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: OCCPTEPS
Field_Delimited.description: Occultation point Earth-Probe-Sun angle, where Probe is the Cassini spacecraft. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: UNCORRDXDT
Field_Delimited.description: Uncorrected time derivative of the integrated electron column density. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: CORRDXDT
Field_Delimited.description: Corrected time derivative of the integrated electron column density. As discussed further in the user guide, some UNCORRDXDT time series (from Column 14) required corrections for baseline trends that were measured before or after occultation. Corrections included subtraction of a median value of UNCORRDXDT, subtraction of a linear trend, or replacement of a spurious data point with an interpolation between the previous and next data points. If no correction was applied, then CORRDXDT will equal UNCORRDXDT from Column 14. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: TEC
Field_Delimited.description: Total electron content (TEC). TEC is the electron number density integrated along the signal path. The constant of integration was chosen so that TEC is zero at the earliest time. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: ELECDEN
Field_Delimited.description: Electron number density. By construction, ELECDEN is zero at the largest value of OCCPTRADIUS. (format code E20.12)

Field_Delimited.name: ELECDENERR
Field_Delimited.description: Uncertainty on ELECDEN from Column 17. The uncertainty is calculated as the standard deviation of ELECDEN in the high altitude baseline portion of the observations before or after occultation. Therefore a single value of ELECDENERR applies to all values of ELECDEN in a given individual electron density profile. (format code E20.12)
